title: Pre-registered out-of-sample directional prediction of a localized regime change
what_is_predicted: A LOCALIZED regime change (critical slowing down → rupture), predicted from the pre-event run-up window ALONE — explicitly NOT 'C keeps rising'. This avoids the integrator/trend confound that makes a naive crossing prediction trivial.

predictor.name: trend_preserving_csd_surrogate_null
predictor.statistic: rising rolling lag-1 autocorrelation + variance (critical slowing down)
predictor.null: trend_preserving_surrogate (keeps trend + residual spectrum, destroys the localized rupture)
predictor.decision: predict transition iff surrogate-null p < alpha

primary_synthetic.negative_control: matched linear twin (feedback off, r=0) — same drive/start/noise, no fold
primary_synthetic.observation_rule: Only C[:jump - lead] is visible to the predictor; the held-out window contains the truth.
primary_synthetic.decision_rule: OOS_SKILL_DEMONSTRATED iff (bistable_tpr > twin_fpr) AND (one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05); else OOS_SKILL_INCONCLUSIVE.

split.test: final 30%, held out, untouched until scoring

secondary_real_data.rule: Apply the SAME localized predictor to the training window only; a positive call is scored against whether a localized regime change occurs in the held-out window. Decision rule and split are frozen here BEFORE scoring; neither may be tuned to the outcome.
secondary_real_data.note: Registered as a forward prediction: committing the rule and split before the result is the pre-registration. Evaluation is future work and must use the localized predictor, never a naive crossing.

exploratory_outcome_before_freeze.honest_note: Reported at equal status to a positive. Per-trajectory CSD prediction is modest-power at short lead (Boettiger & Hastings 2012). The frozen confirmatory protocol above (lead=60) governs future runs; this pre-freeze result does not count as confirmation.

amendment_policy: Any change to predictor, params, split or decision rule requires a NEW dated pre-registration. This file is append-only by supersession.
